name: Ibrox Bar Benidorm
title: The Ibrox Bar | A Must-Visit Destination for Rangers Fans in Benidorm
description: Discover The Ibrox Bar in Benidorm, a welcoming spot for sports fans with fantastic food, friendly staff, and a vibrant atmosphere. Enjoy reasonable prices and excellent service while cheering for Rangers or soaking in the British theme. Perfect for match
paragraphs: The Ibrox Bar, nestled in Benidorm, is a haven for football enthusiasts and a must-visit for Rangers fans. Patrons rave about its inviting atmosphere and the warm, friendly service. As Kerri Lakin notes, it’s a “great wee spot” where staff ensure everyone feels at home while offering fantastic food and drinks. The bar’s British theme enhances the experience, making it resonate with both locals and visitors alike.

Melinda Shaw highlights the reasonable prices and vibrant ambiance, while Karen Richardson emphasizes the quick service and great vibes on match days. Even fans of rival teams, like Scott Brown from Nottingham, enjoy the lively setting and diverse menu options including delicious pizza and chips. Robert Stevenson praises the hearty breakfast and multiple sports screens, making it the perfect spot for any Rangers match day.
Overall, The Ibrox Bar is a delightful fusion of sports culture and culinary pleasure, sure to leave every guest satisfied.
Via Cassia Nord, 108, 53035 Monteriggioni SI, Italy
